doc.title: Howard Alden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997

title: Opening of the Aspen interview
summary: Monk Rowe opens the filming at Aspen and greets Alden, born in California in 1958.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: We are filming today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive in Aspen, Colorado. And it’s a pleasure to be with Howard Alden today, guitarist.
Welcome to out west. Being born in 1958 in California — is that right?
